text:
Jennifer Adams
Elizabeth Community Health Center 
125 Munno Parra Avenue 
Elizabeth, 5098

29, November, 2017

Dear Ms Adams

Re: Mr Martin Wilson, aged 63

I am writing to refer Mr Wilson who requires your consultation for his depression and gambling addiction urgently after his discharge on 24 October.

Mr Wilson has been suffering from depression in relation to his gambling addiction, which has made him loose friends and financial stability. After attempting suicide with an overdose of Mogodol, he was admitted to our hospital and has been placed on anti-depressants, Lovan 200g. The incident shocked his family as none of them was aware of his depression. He regrets his action and wants to overcome his addiction. 

Mr. Wilson has also been diagnosed recently with type 2 diabetes, under oral medications and low GI diet. He is still physically unfit with poor appetite, and will need a walking aid for mobility after his discharge. 

Although Mr. Wilson will visit Dr. Brian regularly after discharge, your assistance and support will be an urgent need for his recovery. Please arrange a gambling addiction therapy and the support group at your center for him. He will also need to be encouraged in seeking help with Quitline and reengaging in social activities. 

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Yours sincerely,
RN 
180W
